import { type Command, type CommandContext } from '../cli/command.ts';
import { join, type ParsedPath } from 'node:path';
import type { Logger } from '../cli/logger.ts';
export { type Finding, findingAt } from '../lint/finding.ts';
export type { Rule } from '../lint/finding.ts';

/** Uses the imports so nothing is unused. */
export function describe(command: Command, context: CommandContext, parsed: ParsedPath, log: Logger): string {
  log.info(command.name);
  return join(context.cwd, parsed.base);
}
